source: 721 Exhausting the Substitutes
target: 721 Substitutiones Exhaurientes

source: A Demoness of Pleasure didn’t possess an innately proactive charm, but she could maximize her allure to irresistible levels.
target: Demonissa Voluptatis indolem proactivam naturalem non habebat, sed suam venustatem ad gradus irresistibiles extollere poterat.

source: Even under normal circumstances, her magnetism could make most men unable to shift their gazes away, their breathing growing labored as their minds raced with desire.
target: Etiam sub ordinariis condicionibus, eius magnetismus plerosque viros efficiebat ut oculos ab illa avertire non possent, cum respiratio eorum difficilis fieret et mentes desiderio ferventi incitabantur.

source: Moran Avigny had certainly never been an Ascetic, and his lust was already inflamed by Beatrice’s Necklace.
target: Moran Avigny certe numquam asceticus fuit, et eius concupiscentia a Collāre Beatricis iam inflammata erat.

source: His focus was solely locked on Franca now, imagination running wild with tantalizing possibilities of what might happen next.
target: Nunc sola eius intentio in Francā fixa erat, dum imaginātio ferociter per tentantes eventūs futūrōs vagabatur.

source: Heart pounding, blood surging, his movements were affected—swift but erratic.
target: Cor pulsans, sanguis effluens, et motūs eius celerēs sed incertae erant.

source: A dawn-like glow emanated from Moran’s body, marking Franca as the target of his righteous punishment.
target: Fulgor quasi aurōrae ex corpore Morānī emanavit, Francam designāns ut scopum poenāe iustae eius.

source: This enhanced his influence and offensive power against the tempting demoness.
target: Hoc ejus auctoritatem et vim offensivam adversus demonissam voluptātis incitantem augebat.

source: As he selected her for punishment, Moran seemed to grow taller in Franca’s eyes, striking fear into her heart.
target: Eligendo eam ad supplicium, Morānus in oculīs Francae altior apparēre videbātur, incūtens timorem in cordā eius.

source: She sensed he was a formidable figure who could end her existence with a mere thought.
target: Sentīvit eum esse formidābilem, qui sola cogitātiōne eius vitam termināre posset.

source: She broke invisibility and tried to quickly shift positions.
target: Invisibilitātem fregit et celeriter locum mutāre conātā est.

source: Seizing the opportunity, Moran thrust out his right hand, breathing hot and heavy, and spoke an ancient Hermes incantation: “Imprison!”
target: Occasiōnem capiens, Morānus dextram manum protulit, calide et grave spirāns, et antiquam incantātiōnem Hermetis edixit: “Constringe!”

source: Viscous amber liquid surged forth, enveloping Franca and freezing the demoness in place within a colossal transparent prison.
target: Liquum ambra viscosum erupit, Francam amplectēns et demonissam in loco ingenti carcere translūcēnte immobilizāns.

source: Crack!
target: Crepitus!

source: Franca’s form shattered, transforming into a palm-sized makeup mirror.
target: Forma Francae confracta est, atque in speculum palmae mensūra conversum est.

source: This allowed her to escape the Disciplinary Paladin’s Imprison.
target: Hoc illi concessit ut evaderet clausa Palātī Disciplināri.

source: Suddenly, powerful danger premonition gripped Moran.
target: Subito, praemonitio periculi potentis Morānum obsēdit.

source: Straining his enhanced physique, he broke free of the intangible spider silk ensnaring him and dove to the side.
target: Corpus suum auctum exercentem, a telīs arāneae intangibilī, quae eum prehendebant, liberātus est et ad lātus desiluit.

source: Jenna’s ice spike wreathed in unholy black flames narrowly missed its mark as she struck with all her might from the diagonal flank.
target: Spīcula glaciei Jennāe, nigrīs flammīs impiīs involuta, vix destinātum attingebat, dum ex lātere diagonālī omni vi percutiebat.

source: Moran’s eyes flicked to the Witch in her dark dress and bonnet.
target: Oculī Morānī ad magam in vestī obscūrā et pileō conversī sunt.

source: He couldn’t help but think she was quite appealing too.
target: Non potuit quin existimāret eam quoque valde allicientem esse.

source: Why not have both?
target: Cur nōn utrumque habēre?

source: Dropping to one knee, Moran reached out towards Jenna and bellowed another Hermes invocation: “Confinement!”
target: Ad genu dēcidēns, Morānus ad Jennam protulit et aliam incantātiōnem Hermetis edīxit: “Contine!”

source: Wordlessly, an immaterial wall materialized around Jenna, impenetrable even to her Spirit Body.
target: Sine verbīs, mūrus immaterialis circa Jennam apparuit, quī nōn etiam ad corpus spirituale eius penetrare poterat.

source: Rather than adhering directly to her, it generated a transparent cell with her at its center, thwarting any attempt at Mirror Substitution.
target: Pro eo quod directe eam complectere nōn poterat, cellam translūcēntem creāvit, in quā illa in mediō constitui erat, omni conātū substitutionis speculī obsistens.

source: Taking note of this, Jenna opted not to strike the unseen barrier.
target: Hoc observāns, Jennā decernit nōn percutere obstāculum invisibile.

source: Instead, she enveloped herself in a layer of frost.
target: Potius, se in strātō glaciæ cingit.

source: Beyond the frost was another layer of frost—a delicate vacuum formed, transforming Jenna into a frozen statue.
target: Ultrā glaciem erat aliud strātum glaciæ, vacuum delicatum formāns, quod Jennam in statuam congelatam convertit.

source: “Confinement!”
target: “Contine!”

source: Moran Avigny didn’t immediately press his advantage against Jenna.
target: Morānus Avigny nōn statim suam utilitātem adversus Jennam extulit.

source: His bloodshot eyes fixed on Franca as he confined the space surrounding the Demoness of Pleasure.
target: Oculī eius, ruborē affectī, in Francam fixī erant, dum spatium circa demonissam voluptātis continebat.

source: Franca remained unresponsive as black flames surged forth from her form.
target: Francā immota remansit, dum ex eius forma flammae nigræ erumpere coeperunt.

source: Outside the black blaze, strata of frost coalesced, fashioning a translucent, sturdy sarcophagus.
target: Extra ignem nigrum, strāta glaciei conglutinabantur, formantes sarcophāgum rōbustum et translūcentem.

source: Transparent spider silk wound around her, cocooning the frost in spirals.
target: Translūcentēs telā arāneā circa eam circumvolvit, glaciem in spirīs convolvens.

source: Wh— Moran Avigny, though perplexed by the Demoness of Pleasure’s peculiar behavior, took satisfaction in the success of his Confinement, circumventing the effects of Mirror Substitution.
target: Heu— Morānus Avigny, quamvis de mōribus peculiāribus demonissae voluptātis perplexus, in successū continentiae suā delectābātur, effectūs substitutionis speculī circumfugēns.

source: His movements somewhat warped, he lunged at Franca.
target: Motūs eius aliquantulum deformātī erant; impetum ad Francam fecit.

source: His mind raced with the powers he would unleash next and the consequences of bringing her under his control.
target: Mensa eius celeriter currit de viribus quās sequenti emittens atque de consequentiīs eam sub potestate redigendi.

source: He had almost forgotten the presence of the Spectator, but Anthony had slipped into a blind spot.
target: Fere oblītus erat praesentiae Speculatoris, sed Anthony in angulō caeco lapsus est.

source: No matter, I’ll subdue the two Demonesses first!
target: Nihil refert, duās demonissās primum subīgam!

source: The instant this notion crossed Moran Avigny’s mind, a faintly piercing melody abruptly resounded in his ears.
target: Cum ista cogitātiō mentem Morānī Avigny attingeret, tenuis et acūtus melos subito in auribus eius resonavit.

source: Lumian stepped out from the corner shadows, the black Symphony of Hatred bone flute at his lips.
target: Lumian ex angulō umbrārum processit, flautā ossium nigrā Symphoniā Odīī ad labiīs habēns.

source: Prohibition of Invisibility hadn’t compelled him to reveal himself, as he wasn’t invisible to begin with.
target: Interdictiō invisibilitātis eum nōn coegit se ostendere, nam ab initio invisibilis nōn erat.

source: He had merely shape-shifted into a shadow being, blending with the shadows!
target: Modo se in ens umbrārum versūtum mutāvit, cum umbrīs coniungēns!

source: Lumian studied Moran Avigny’s face, twisted by desire.
target: Lumian faciem Morānī Avigny, desideriō distortam, perspexit.

source: Approaching with a grin, he played the melody with intensified vigor.
target: Accedēns cum risū, melodiam cum augetō vigōre canēns.

source: Given Moran Avigny’s state, he was certain the Symphony of Hatred’s exploitation of vulnerabilities would undeniably inflame the other’s cravings.
target: Considerātō statu Morānī Avigny, certus erat quod usus vulnerābilitātum per Symphoniam Odīī alīus cupiditās indubitanter inflammāret.

source: Employing his Fate Appropriator’s abilities in tandem was unnecessary.
target: Facultātēs Fātī Appropriatoris simul adhibēre supervacuum esse videbātur.

source: Amid the lively, cutting music, Moran Avigny’s body abruptly went rigid.
target: Inter musicam vivacem et acutam, corpus Morānī Avigny subito rigescit.

source: With a cracking noise, he invoked Mirror Substitution to endure the nearly lethal assault on his behalf.
target: Cum crepitu, Substitutionem Speculī invocāvēt, ut impetum fere letālem sibi tolerāret.

source: Moran Avigny’s silhouette manifested behind Lumian, but Lumian’s performance persisted, and the nigh-explosive lust gripping Moran Avigny remained unabated.
target: Silhouetta Morānī Avigny post Luminum apparuit, sed actiō Luminum perseverābat, et luxuria paene explosīva, quā Morānus Avigny teneātur, nōn cessābat.

source: Crack! Crack! Crack!
target: Crepitus! Crepitus! Crepitus!

source: Moran Avigny’s form repeatedly fractured like a mirror, rematerializing in the ever-quickening melody.
target: Forma Morānī Avigny iterum quasi speculum confracta est, et in melodiā semper accelerantī rematerializāta est.

source: He couldn’t flee the vicinity, nor could he spare a moment to obstruct his hearing.
target: Nōn potuit exīre vicinitātem, neque tempus habuit ut auditum suum impedīret.

source: The captivating strains of the Symphony of Hatred permeated every nook of the space behind the mirror.
target: Notae captivānēs Symphoniae Odīī omnem angulum spatii post speculum impregnāverunt.

source: Anthony crouched in a corner, employing a prop he had readied beforehand to shield his ears.
target: Anthony in angulō incumbēns, utens instrumentō iam praeparātō ad aurēs suas tuendās.

source: He was set to bank on the mirror to induce a trance and plunge into deep sleep, thus evading Lumian’s lethal melody that spared neither friend nor foe.
target: Ipse constituit speculum ut ūtiliter ad transe inducendum et in profundum somnum se immergeret, ita melos letālem Luminum, quī neque amicos neque hostēs parcit, evitāns.

source: Despite his preparations, grayish-white dragon scales involuntarily surfaced on his skin.
target: Nōn obstānte praeparātiōne, squamārum dracōrum cinereo-albārum in cute eius involuntāriē apparuērunt.

source: Crack! Crack! Moran Avigny’s Mirror Substitution had at last been exhausted.
target: Crepitus! Crepitus! Substitutio Speculī Morānī Avigny tandem exhausta fuit.

source: His mind reeled, and he experienced overwhelming pleasure, a surge of euphoria.
target: Mens eius vertiginem sensit, atque voluptatem ingentem ac euphoriā impetu percipiēbat.

source: His frame shuddered with pain and rapture.
target: Corpus eius dolore et extāsī concussum tremebat.

source: Blood seeped from his nostrils, eyes, ears, and mouth.
target: Sanguis ex nāribus, oculīs, auribus, et ore eius effluxit.

source: His saliva, mucus, and tears streamed all at once, as though he teetered on the brink of collapse.
target: Salīva, mucus, et lacrimae eius simul effluērunt, quasi in mārgine ruinae versāretur.

source: Lumian appeared behind him, lowered the Symphony of Hatred, and snorted.
target: Lumian post eum apparuit, Symphoniam Odīī deiecit, et sibilāvit.

source: Twin beams of white light struck Moran Avigny, plunging the Disciplinary Paladin into unconsciousness.
target: Geminae radiī lucis albae Morānum Avigny percussērunt, immergentes Palātum Disciplinārium in inōscientiam.

source: Lumian afforded Moran Avigny no opportunity to harness his unique powers to rouse himself.
target: Lumian Moranum Avigny nullam occāsiōnem praebuit ut singulārēs vires ad se excitandum adhiberet.

source: He produced a ritualistic dog skin from his Traveler’s Bag and draped it over the gradually crumpling foe’s head.
target: Ex sacco Viātōris suō pellem canem ritualem eduxit et super caput hostis paulatim corruentis appōsuīt.

source: “Dog!” Lumian declared in Hermes.
target: “Canis!” Lumian in Hermetis edixit.

source: With a shadowy flash, Moran Avigny vanished, supplanted by an enormous dog with tawny fur.
target: Cum umbrātā micātiōne, Morānus Avigny evanuit, substitūtus ab canī ingenti cum pilīs fulvīs.

source: Amid the intangible thud of the dog collapsing to the ground, it lay insensible on its flank.
target: Inter impalpābilēs tonitruum canis in terram corruentis, ille in lātere suō insensibilis iacebat.

source: Lumian smiled, stooped down, and scooped up the dog.
target: Lumian subrīdēns se inclinavit et canem in brachiō suscepit.

source: Witnessing this, Anthony dislodged the gag that had wholly covered his ears, and Jenna shed the dual layers of frost encasing her.
target: Hoc vidēns, Anthony impedimēntum quod aurēs eius omnīnō tegebat tollere conātus est, et Jennā duplicēs strātās glaciæ quae eam involvērant removit.

source: Franca lagged slightly.
target: Franca paululō morāta est.

source: After a handful of seconds, the cocoon ruptured, and the ice coffin noiselessly dissipated, prompting the black flames to disperse.
target: Post paucos secundōs, involucrum ruptum est, et sarcophagus glaciæ sine sonō evanuit, quā flammae nigræ dissipārī coeperunt.

source: She regarded Lumian and Jenna with astonishment and delight, stating, “My Pleasure potion underwent substantial digestion!”
target: Illōs Lumian et Jennam stupōre et laetiā aspexit, dīcēns: “Potio mea Voluptātis ingentem digestionem passā est!”

source: No sooner had she concluded her statement than she pinched her nose and surveyed the spot where Moran Avigny had stood and the massive dog cradled in Lumian’s arms.
target: Nōn proculquam postquam loquāta est, nāsum sibi premit, et locum contemplāta est ubi Morānus Avigny steterat et ingens canis in brachiīs Luminum tenerētur.

source: “I know what’s going on… He must have just savored genuine pleasure—utmost pleasure. Moreover, this ‘pleasure’ stemmed from me.”
target: «Scio quid agatur… Eum modo veram, maximam voluptatem experīrī debuisse; praeterea, haec “voluptās” ex me orta est.»

source: Lumian deliberated momentarily before replying, “He even staked his life to remain in pursuit of the pleasure you bestowed upon him, weathering the same excruciating agony. Ultimately, he attained the pleasure he coveted, albeit not in the manner he desired. He paid the steepest price for it.”
target: Lumian paulisper deliberāvit, deinde respondentēs dīxit: “Etiam vitam suam ponit ut in persequenda voluptate, quam tibi tribuistī, perseveret, eidem atrocem dolorem ferēns; denique voluptatem quam concupīvit adeptus est, etiamsi nōn eo mōdō quo desiderābat; pretium summum pro ea solvit.”

source: “He’s also a Beyonder on par with Sequence 5,” Franca remarked with a wistful smile.
target: “Is etiam Beyonder aequus Sequentiā V,” Franca sub risū desiderōso inquit.

source: “Regrettably, I wasn’t the one wielding the Symphony of Hatred; otherwise, my Pleasure potion might have been fully digested. Pleasure begets pain, and pleasure lures people into depravity. Pleasure is akin to a candle flame to a moth…”
target: “Infeliciter, nōn ego eram quī Symphoniam Odīī gerebam; alioquin, potio mea Voluptātis plene digestus esse potuissēt. Voluptās dolorem gignit, et voluptas hominēs in pravitātem allicit. Voluptās similis est flammae candelæ ad papilionem…”

source: At this juncture, she lowered her voice and mumbled in an unfamiliar tongue, “Lust is a dangerous game…”
target: Hac hōra, vocem attenuat et in lingua ignota murmurāvīt: “Libīdō lusus periculōsus est…”

source: Franca harbored no excessive regrets. Among them, only Lumian could shoulder the adverse cost of the Symphony of Hatred.
target: Francā nimias dolōrēs nōn habēbat; inter omniōrum, sōlus Lumian onus adversum Symphoniae Odīī portāre poterat.

source: Anthony scanned the environs and serenely prompted Franca, “Since we’ve succeeded, let’s leave quickly.”
target: Anthony ambi­tum perlustrāvit et Francam tranquillitāte provocāvīt: “Cum successimus, cito eāmus.”

source: Jenna had already drawn near to Lumian, who had likewise stowed away the Symphony of Hatred.
target: Jennā iam prope Luminum accesserat, quī simīliter Symphoniam Odīī in receptāculō condiderat.

source: “Okay.” Franca nodded and took several paces to Lumian’s side, grasping his upper arm.
target: “Okay.” Franca annuit et aliquot passūs ad Luminum accessit, bracchium eius superiōrem arripiēns.

source: Concurrently, black flames ignited behind the mirror.
target: Simul, flammae nigræ post speculum accensae sunt.

source: Within seconds, the quartet emerged from the fixed portal to the mirror world in the quarry cave. Franca finalized the anti-divination and anti-prophecy measures.
target: Post paucōs secundōs, quaternio ex portāle fīxo ad mundum speculī in spelunca lapicidā emersit. Franca mensūrās antidivinationis et antiprophetiārum dēfīnīvit.

source: Subsequently, they teleported back to the secured residence in the administrative district.
target: Deinde, teletransportātī ad dōmicilium securum in districtū administratīvo redierunt.

source: Franca sighed. “Beatrice’s Necklace can no longer trigger Lust…”
target: Francā suspirāvīt: “Collāre Beatricis libidinem excitāre nōn iam potest…”

source: Beatrice’s Necklace could only trigger such desires twice. The inaugural target of Lust was Gardner Martin.
target: Collāre Beatricis talem dēsīderium bis tantum excitāre poterat. Prīmum propositum libidinis erat Gardner Martin.

source: For Demoness Franca, this signified the loss of a potent auxiliary means.
target: Pro Demonissā Francā, hoc instrumentī auxiliī validī amissiōnem significābat.

source: Jenna nodded slightly. “How unfortunate. It appears the Demoness of Pleasure and the Sex Addict of the Mother Tree of Desire pathway can forge an ideal and efficacious partnership.”
target: Jennā paulum annuit: “Quam infausta rēs. Vidētur demonissa voluptātis atque addicta sexualis, per viam arboris maternī dēsīderī, societātem optimum et efficacem condere posse.”

source: “Indeed. Unfortunately, I cannot obtain the Mother Tree of Desire’s boon. Otherwise…” Franca abruptly fell silent, and an identical phrase flitted through the minds of Lumian and the others: Sex Addict Demoness!
target: “Revera. Infeliciter, beneficium arboris maternī dēsīderī acquirere nōn possum. Alioquin…” Franca subito tacevit, et eadem sententia per mentes Luminum et cēterōrum volitavit: “Demonissa addicta sexualis!”

source: Clearing her throat twice, Franca said, “I can only hope that the bestowed of the Mother Tree of Desire will bestow comparable props.”
target: Bis guttur purgāns, Franca inquit: “Spero tantum ut beneficium arboris maternī dēsīderī subsidia similia referat.”

source: She turned to the enfeebled dog, who had yet to stir, and contemplated briefly before proposing, “Administer truth serum to him first, then have Anthony befriend him as a two-pronged approach? Yes, employ the Magic Mirror Spirit Channeling Spell as a precautionary step…”
target: Ad canem debilitātum, quī nōn dē movit, conversus est et paulisper meditātus, deinde proponēns: “Prīmō illī serum veritātis impōnitē, deinde Anthony eum amīcitiam inīre cūret, ut modus duplex efficiātur? Itaque incantātiōnem Mirābilī Speculī Spiritūs Canalizātiōnis ut gradus cautiōnis adhibeāmus…”

source: Lumian nodded, recollecting the “criticism” the Demoness of Black had leveled at Franca. Quelling his avarice, he said, “No need to rush. I’ll question him after visiting Mr. K. Mr. K must have his motives for abruptly targeting Moran Avigny for assassination. Only by consulting him can we extract more pertinent intelligence later.”
target: Lumian annuit, recordāns “criticismum” quod Demonissa Nigra Francae intulisset. Avaritiam reprimēns, dīxit: “Nullum festinandum est; postquam dominum K. visitāverō, eum interrogābō. Dominus K. certe causam habet cur subitātem pro Morānī Avigny caedem petat. Solum eum consulendō plūra intellegentia extrahere possumus.”

source: Franca and the others nodded in concurrence. “Agreed.”
target: Franca et cēterī unanimiter annuērunt: “Consentimus.”

source: Lumian alighted from the carriage, attired in a light-blue cotton shirt following a change of clothing, and entered the six-story white luxurious residence.
target: Lumian e currū descendit, indūtus camisā alba caeruleā ex cotōne post mutātiōnem vestimentōrum, et intrāvit domum sex strātīs albae et opulentae.
